result.scope: All retained loops are unadmitted diagnostics. Zero area screen exposes sub-resolution/small loops for review, not measured eddies. Local level scan is distinct from the prior fixed-level 4000 km2 pilot. Do not pool nested contours into a physical uncertainty or seasonal range.

scientific_findings: Both demeaning methods retain 17 nested closed-contour diagnostics near the independently reported Deviant center. They share the grid peak at 88.4375 W,27.8125 N, about 33.17 km from the reported SST center. This is spatial correspondence, not physical identity verification.

The nearest native gridpoint to the rounded source center is 88.6875 W,27.9375 N. Its arithmetic Gulf-demeaned ADT is about +0.0292 m, below the prior +0.15/+0.17/+0.19 m levels. The failed fixed-level detection must not be interpreted as feature absence.
Smaller nested contours have as little as one sampled interior gridpoint; a closed contour alone is insufficient support for a resolved eddy dimension.
The scan includes larger contours at its lower endpoint. It does not establish the outermost closed contour. Do not report an outer radius or pool all contour sizes into an uncertainty range.

For peak-relative contours and gradients, subtraction of a constant field offset should cancel. Demeaning alternatives are not independent uncertainty realizations for the proposed speed-contour method.
